attributes.name: Kestoglyr Mantiel
attributes.powers:
Kestoglyr Mantiel is immune to the Mental and Poison traits. If the check to defeat has the Corrupted trait, add 1d8.

Before you act, Kestoglyr Mantiel deals 1d4+1 Cold damage to each character at your location that has the Divine skill.

During the encounter, characters may not play blessings that do not have the Corrupted trait.
